messages.subject: Calculate DIC and WAIC manually
parts:
To calculate DIC and WAIC the codes are as follows:
model$dic$dic
model$waic$waic

While the formula for calculating them is -2 * (log likelihood - effective number of parameters). To calculate these criterion manually the codes are as follows:

DIC = -2 * (model$mlik[2] - model.f1$dic$p.eff)
WAIC = -2 * (model$mlik[2] - model.f1$waic$p.eff

But the results are not same at all, why?
